decisions.reason: The source changes the artistic style of the three characters, not the quality, resolution, regeneration, or shot-angle rules for backgrounds and sets.
The request for a character-style pass does not change the established clarification process for shots that deviate from the storyboard.
The character-aesthetic revision does not alter which script or detailed shot directions govern trailer shots.
Although Q and Deadwax appear in the CC1 sequence, changing their artistic style does not alter that sequence's framing progression, shot-pair count, or opening wide-shot requirement.
